64-5929-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
64-5929-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Leyline of Transformation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Warden of the Eye token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2085-2645-3147-3430.easyPrerequisites: Kelpie Guide doesn't have summoning sickness.
2085-2645-3147-3430.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4875-4881-6909-8200.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4875-4881-6909-8200.description:
Cast Grub's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

1339-7818-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-7818-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2099-4694-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2099-4694-5805-7306.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

1479-2841-7889-8101.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Wooded Foothills.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-7889-8101.description:
Fetch a land using Wooded Foothills.
When the fetched land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4247-4550-5567-7824--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4247-4550-5567-7824--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

3175-3899-3991.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7322-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Big Mother Mouser.
When Big Mother Mouser dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7725.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Selfless Police Captain.
When Selfless Police Captain dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2457-4289-5434-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.n: Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury

2726-5465-7043.description:
Cast Aang by paying {W}{U}
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying Aang.
Resolve the copy of the Aang spell. When it enters, it triggers, airbending the Aang spell still on the stack.
Cast the Aang spell from exile by paying {0}.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying Aang.
Resolve the copy of the Aang spell. Put either Aang token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Aang token from step 5 enters, it triggers, airbending the Aang spell still on the stack.
Repeat from step 4.

1824-2530-5061-6709.easyPrerequisites:
You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
1824-2530-5061-6709.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Staff of the Death Magus triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

4871-5220-6650-6797.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
4871-5220-6650-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-6650-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1358-3899-4552-6753.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Sydri.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

914-3036-7060.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3036-7060.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

104-360-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-360-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3490-4506-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-4506-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1987-2493-3227-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2493-3227-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Scrivener.
When Archaeomancer and Scrivener enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2493-3227-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

465-997-3817.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

671-1497-2173-5220.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Wild Cantor enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1456-1987-4087-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Lavabrink Floodgates by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Lavabrink Floodgates.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

3609-3921-6750.notablePrerequisites: Inspirit has one or more charge counters on it.
3609-3921-6750.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Inspirit triggers, putting three charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1088-2060-5686-6701.description:
Activate Persistent Specimen by paying {2}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Persistent Specimen.
When Persistent Specimen is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{B}.
Repeat.
1088-2060-5686-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

3490-4050-5070-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4050-5070-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1308-1409-6348.notablePrerequisites: You control a Dragon and/or have a Dragon card in hand.
1308-1409-6348.description:
Activate Sarkhan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sarkhan enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Sarkhan trigger, either choosing a Dragon you control or revealing a Dragon card from your hand and creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sarkhan.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

586-2510-5256-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
586-2510-5256-5258-5618.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Priest of Gix's power.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1116-3240-5670-6094.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3240-5670-6094.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Sek'Kuar trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Nether Traitor trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

1165-2861-3174.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Archfiend of the Dross has no more than four oil counters on it.
1165-2861-3174.description:
Cast Heartless Act by paying {1}{B}, removing up to three oil counters from Archfiend of the Dross.
Cast Switcheroo by paying {4}{U}, exchanging control of Archfiend of the Dross and a creature with an opponent.
At the beginning of the opponent's next upkeep, Archfiend of the Dross triggers, causing the opponent to remove an oil counter from it and lose the game.

4241-4740.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Your life total is at least 51.
4241-4740.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Aetherflux Reservoir to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target and causing you to gain 50 life.
Repeat step 3.

1799-2034-2048-3621.notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of eight or greater.
1799-2034-2048-3621.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

678-1636-3652-4534.notablePrerequisites: Barrage Ogre does not have summoning sickness.
678-1636-3652-4534.description:
Activate Barrage Ogre by tapping it and sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Barrage Orge ability, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat.

592-904-4126.description:
Cast Role Reversal by paying {U}{U}{R}, exchanging control of an enchantment an opponent controls and Nefarious Lich.
Activate Despotic Scepter by tapping it, destroying Nefarious Lich.
When Nefarious Lich leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing its controller to lose the game.

251-2034-4184.notablePrerequisites:
Denry Klin has at least one -1/-1 counter on it.
Relentless Skaabs does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
251-2034-4184.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs, adding {C}{C}.
Relentless Skaabs dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Relentless Skaabs enters the battlefield, triggering Denry Klin, putting a -1/-1 counter on Relentless Skaabs.
Repeat.

2047-2719-3094-4659.notablePrerequisites: Mechanized Production attached to Lithoform Engine.
2047-2719-3094-4659.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Mechanized Production trigger.
Resolve the copy of Mechanized Production's ability, creating a token copy of Lithoform Engine.
Activate the Lithoform Engine token's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Mechanized Production trigger.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Lithoform Engine token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

1766-2751-4404-4711.notablePrerequisites:
Corridor Monitor does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three opponents.
1766-2751-4404-4711.description:
Declare Corridor Monitor as an attacker, triggering its myriad ability.
Holding priority, activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Corridor Monitor's myriad trigger.
Resolve the copy of Corridor Monitor's myriad trigger, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor that is tapped and attacking each other opponent.
The Corridor Monitor tokens enter the battlefield, untapping Thran Dynamo and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

431-1744-4772.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating ten token copies of Lullmage Mentor.
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate a Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven Merfolk you control, countering that spell.
Each Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating twice that many 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

1603-3270-5220.description:
Cast Evil Twin by paying {2}{U}{B}, having it enter the battlefield as a copy of Gyruda.
Put Evil Twin into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Mortuary triggers, putting Evil Twin on top of your library from your graveyard.
Evil Twin's enter the battlefield ability triggers, causing each player to mill four cards and you to return Evil Twin from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Gyruda.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-2692-3147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2692-3147.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Felidar Retreat, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-3035-5003.description:
Sacrifice Nadier to Ashnod's Altar to add {C}{C}.
Nadier triggers, creating five 1/1 Elf Warrior tokens.
Sacrifice one of the tokens to Ashnod's Altar to add {C}{C}.
Pay {4} to the Nim Deathmantle trigger to return Nadier to the battlefield equipped with Nim Deathmantle.
Repeat.

351-2275-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Dagger attached to Famished Paladin.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
351-2275-3957.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to draw a card and deal 1 damage to target player.
When you draw a card, Shabraz will trigger, gaining you 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Gaining the life untaps Famished Paladin.
Repeat.
